gacc_sections.narrative: * Cedar Hollow, Oklahoma DOF. Twelve miles northeast of Tahlequah, OK. Timber. Minimal fire behavior with creeping. * Merit Creek, National Forests in Mississippi, USFS. Four miles south of McLain, MS. Southern rough. Active fire behavior with flanking and backing. Structures threatened. Hydra, Texas A&M Forest Service. Three miles south of Meridian, TX. Brush and grass. Minimal fire behavior with smoldering. Round Prarie, Louisiana Office of Forestry. Eight miles northwest of Bastrop, LA. Southern rough. Minimal fire behavior with smoldering. Last report unless significant activity occurs.

Dome, Yosemite National Park, NPS. CIMT (CA Team 3). One mile north of Wawona, CA. Timber, brush and heavy slash. Moderate fire behavior with flanking, uphill runs and single tree torching. Area, road and trail closures in effect. Plaskett, Los Padres NF, USFS. CIMT (CA Team 6). CIMT is also managing the Timber incident. Thirty-four miles southwest of Big Sur, CA. Chaparral, grass and timber. Minimal fire behavior with creeping. Area and trail closures in effect. Timber, Los Padres NF, USFS. Four miles southeast of Big Sur, CA. Grass, timber and chaparral. Moderate fire behavior with creeping, backing and uphill runs. Numerous structures and communication infrastructure threatened. Area, road and trail closures in effect.

Little Giant, Okanogan-Wenatchee NF, USFS. CIMT (NW Team 13). CIMT is also managing the Sisi incident. Thirty miles northwest of Leavenworth, WA. Timber and dormant brush. Minimal fire behavior with backing, creeping and smoldering. Structures threatened. Area, road and trail closures in effect. Sisi, Okanogan-Wenatchee NF, USFS. Ten miles northwest of Stehekin, WA. Closed timber litter and timber. Active fire behavior with backing, flanking and isolated torching. Residences and energy infrastructure threatened. Area, road and trail closures in effect. Austin, Mt. Hood NF, USFS. CIMT (CA Team 2). CIMT is also managing The Narrows and Grasshopper incidents. Twenty-five miles southeast of Estacada, OR. Brush, timber and closed timber litter. Minimal fire behavior with smoldering and creeping. Area, road and trail closures in effect. The Narrows, Mt. Hood NF, USFS. Fifteen miles southeast of Estacada, OR. Grass, brush and light slash. Minimal fire behavior with creeping and smoldering. Area, road and trail closures in effect. Grasshopper, Mt. Hood NF, USFS. Fourteen miles southwest of Dufur, OR. Brush, hardwood litter and closed timber litter. Minimal fire behavior with creeping and smoldering. Area, road and trail closures in effect. Hagen, Umatilla NF, USFS. CIMT (NW Team 7). Twenty-six miles east of Pendleton, OR. Timber and brush. Minimal fire behavior with creeping and smoldering. Area, road and trail closures in effect. Rowe Creek Complex, Prineville District, BLM. Transfer of command from CIMT (ODF Team 1) back to the local unit will occur tomorrow. Ten miles south of Fossil, OR. Grass, brush and timber. Minimal fire behavior with smoldering. Three Queens, Okanogan-Wenatchee NF, USFS. Six miles east of Snoqualmie Pass, WA. Timber, brush and grass. Minimal fire behavior with creeping and smoldering. Numerous residences and critical infrastructure threatened. Area, road and trail closures in effect. Reduction in acreage due to more accurate mapping. King, Okanogan-Wenatchee NF, USFS. Seven miles northeast of Snoqualmie Pass, WA. Timber, brush and grass. Moderate fire behavior with backing and creeping. Area, road and trail closures in effect. Goat, Okanogan-Wenatchee NF, USFS. Fifteen miles north of Ronald, WA. Timber, brush and grass. Minimal fire behavior with creeping and smoldering. Area, road and trail closures in effect. Sinlahekin, Northeast Region, Washington DNR. One mile west of Tonasket, WA. Timber, brush and grass. Minimal fire behavior with creeping and smoldering. Area, road and trail closures in effect. Border 2, North Cascades National Park, NPS. Thirty-six miles northeast of Marblemount, WA. Timber. Moderate fire behavior with backing, flanking and creeping. Structures threatened. Area, road and trail closures in effect. Paradise, Umatilla NF, USFS. Eighteen miles east of Milton-Freewater, OR. Timber, grass and brush. Minimal fire behavior with smoldering. Critical infrastructure threatened. Area, road and trail closures in effect.

Chileno, Marin County Fire Department. Nine miles east of Tomales, CA. Grass. Minimal fire behavior. Last report unless significant activity occurs. Floriston, Nevada-Yuba-Placer Unit, Cal Fire. Ten miles northeast of Truckee, CA. Timber and chaparral. No new information.

Moonshine, High Desert District, BLM. Seventeen miles southwest of Wheatland, WY. Timber and brush. Minimal fire behavior with backing. Residences threatened. Swiss Roll, San Juan NF, USFS. Eleven miles east of Pagosa Springs, CO. Timber. Minimal fire behavior with smoldering. Energy infrastructure threatened. Road and trail closures in effect. Precipitation occurred over the fire area yesterday.

Sand Creek, Beaverhead-Deerlodge NF, USFS. Five miles east of Wisdom, MT. Timber, brush and grass. Minimal fire behavior with backing, creeping and smoldering. Structures and communication infrastructure threatened. Area, road and trail closures in effect. Upper Smith, Idaho Panhandle NF, USFS. Six miles west of Porthill, ID. Timber, medium slash and brush. Minimal fire behavior with smoldering. Road and trail closures in effect.
Whiskey, Cibola NF, USFS. Fifteen miles northwest of Mountainair, NM. Timber and brush. Minimal fire behavior with smoldering. Area, road and trail closures in effect.

predictive_services_discussion: An upper level trough will move eastward over the northwest today, bringing southwest winds 15-20 mph with higher gusts along with afternoon relative humidity in the 15-25% range across northeastern California and southeastern Oregon. Higher winds with 25-35 mph gusts are expected across northwestern Nevada including the Sierra Front and western Idaho in combination with RH values of 12-18%. Above normal temperatures continue across the southern Plains and lower Mississippi Valley along with seasonably low RH and locally breezy north winds. Heavy rain at times along with cloud cover and near to below normal temperatures will continue across the desert Southwest. A strong Nor’easter will continue to bring strong winds, heavy rain, and coastal flooding to the mid-Atlantic coast. In Hawaii, Tropical Depression 15-E, forecasted to become Hurricane Nolo will begin to track northward toward the Big Island, bringing heavy rain, flash flooding concerns, and strong winds.
